component.name: HFPredict
component.summary: HF propagation forecasts for amateur radio

description.p: HFPredict tells you which amateur radio bands will reach a place, hour by hour, and how likely a contact is on each. Pick a place, pick a band, describe your radio, and get a forecast worked out on your own computer.

ul.li: A map of where the selected band reaches this hour, in every direction
Every band at every hour of the day, as a chance of contact
The usable window, from the lowest to the highest usable frequency
Your own station: mode, power and an antenna with height and direction
Today's solar readings and the nearest ionosonde measurement, when online

description.p: Forecasts come from the HFcast engine: a faithful Rust translation of VOACAP, the model the US Institute for Telecommunication Sciences has maintained for decades, and Truecast, which tunes the same physics to the day. Both run with no network at all. Online, the app reads current solar conditions from NOAA; you can switch the network off entirely in Preferences.
No account, no tracking, no ads.
